reviews.title: Unsecured and dishonest
reviews.text: One of my two-ways flight was cancelled and ground staff asked me to contact by mail Client service to get refund. I have sent 5 mails without being answered and can not get any refund, even after 7 weeks!
reviews.author: JulianTravel

reviews.title: Good quick flight!
reviews.text: Flight to LPQ on Chinese MA60 propeller aircraft was a bit shaky on takeoff and descent, otherwise okay, small plane was only half full. Best is the cost, half of what Lao Airlines charges...we took off a little early and landed the same. Booking was easy at airport kiosk. Would fly again!
reviews.author: Larry M

reviews.title: Great Domestic Airline
reviews.text: This airline is much cheaper than Lao Airlines and doesn't have such an extensive schedule. They fly Chinese built MA60's and Cessna Caravans which are great little aircraft. Leg room can be an issue so get there early and get a seat in the emergency exit row if this is an issue for you. But whatever the flights are not that long anyway.
reviews.author: MarkusD1

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Basic service on board this propeller aircraft which was comfortable for the short flight from the capital to the northern cultural centre of Luang Prabang. Less than half the price of competitor so was worth it. Thanks for the vote if you found this review helpful
reviews.author: nilintentum_reliquit

reviews.title: No refund after more than 4 months
reviews.text: Booked the flight to fly on 16/8/19 but never managed to get on as it was cancelled due to bad weather. At first they announced it will be delayed until almost 2 hours later another passenger was nice enough to inform us privately that it's already cancelled and asked us to go to the airline office in the airport to collect our luggage. Not much to complain here as it wasn't their fault it was cancelled. But up till now I haven't received a refund after waiting for more than 4 months despite repeated follow up emails sent. Never book a flight with them unless it's dry season or you have no other transportation choice.
reviews.author: LLN

reviews.title: Exciting flight
reviews.text: We had a great flight on a Cessna plane ,there was good legroom ,the flight left on time and landed a few minuters before schedule. Since it was a small plane only 11 seats we had e great wiev the whole time, they ewen offered us snacks for a 45 minute flight.
reviews.author: lovingportugal125

reviews.title: It was okay
reviews.text: I must admit I was afraid of flying with them. It all started at the airport when a kind of receipt alike boarding card was issued for us, then we boarded the small plane which was making clapping noise while taking off. But after having reached the sky, everything went okay. We got a small snack, arrived, all okay.
reviews.author: Veronika S.

reviews.title: A rather decent flight
reviews.text: Everything went so smooth. Booking was very easy, and a decent price. Communication, and e mails good. Check in very quick and efficient. Boarding, again efficient. Good flight, decent food, (free). Cabin crew nice and friendly. Left and arrived on time. Disembarking again smooth. Was fun being on one of the small propeller planes for a change...
reviews.author: alisdair t

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised. It was only an one hour flight and yet we got a tasty snack and water. Service was really friendly as expected of Lao people. There was comfortable leg room and my legs are really long. Overall, well worth the price.
reviews.author: Shashitha Tudugalle

reviews.title: Very, very good
reviews.text: LPQ to VTE - Ticket Departure time 13:35, at airport departure time 13:30, actual take off time 13:20 - bit weird. Take out is arrive well early. Checkin breeze. Interesting (new) chinese propeller aircraft. Summary - love them for the price. Price was half that of other airline.
reviews.author: David C

reviews.title: Good economy airline
reviews.text: I have flown with them a number of times without issue. Last flight i took this week from Pakse to Vientiane was canceled but they walked me over to Lao Airlines and made sure i was rebooked. The wait was only about 30 minutes longer. I am american and live in Luang Prabang, Laos
reviews.author: Bruce T

reviews.title: Flawless flight - took off 5 mins early, smooth flight and landed early
reviews.text: I booked my flight same day to travel from Vientiane to Pakse. This airline was nearly 3 times cheaper than its competitors and of course I was a bit dubious. However Im delighted to say I was pleasantly surprised - took off 5 mins early and landed 20 mins ahead of schedule. I also found the staff friendly and helpful both at check in and on board.
reviews.author: theresewalsh

reviews.title: I was pleasantly surprised. Flawless flight. But skip the snacks.
reviews.text: We took the 12:00 noon flight from VTE to LPQ. Flight time was only 45 minutes. We took off exactly on time, landed exactly on time. Plane was very small, but seats were no more cramped than any other puddle jumper like this. Land and air crew were both kind enough. Luggage arrived with no problems. My only warning is you should skip the snacks. Laos is generally known for amazing food, but whatever Lao Skyway served was inedible.
reviews.author: PatrickM_Travels

reviews.title: A bit risky but has its perks
reviews.text: We have booked our flight with them online 4 days in advance. There were 3 types of tickets, the third being the most expensive, 'flexi' category. There was absolutely no difference shwon between the first two other than 100.000 kips. We went with the cheapest, got the confirmation email. (No online check-in available but that's no bother). The flight was at 9 am. Now on the day before, we decided that it would be nice to make a detour to Vang Vieng so we had our hotel staff call them and ask if we can cancel. Turns out we can and they confirmed the cancellation right away on the phone, stating that later they'll send an email. Which they didn't. We wrote to them later that day as it would have been nice to know whether to show up at the airport or can go to the bus station to make our VV trip. On the morning of the departure we were still fully in doubt so headed to the airport where they told us at the counter that we were indeed cancelled (again, a heads-up would have been nice as it's weird to rely solely on an indirect phone call). Were directed to the counter for refund where they told us that they'll transfer the money back in 45 days and that they'll send and email (which they didn't) This kind of ease at an airline company was a very foreign experience to me but i was glad that they were flexible. They are rubbish on the communication part. Oh and the 9 am flight was actually leaving at 8:30 as we found out at the airport.
reviews.author: gabizsiros

reviews.title: Most Unprofessional Business I've Ever Come Across
reviews.text: My flight, as you can see from the attachment, was scheduled for 13:30. I get to the airport and the airport is closed. I get a ride to the Laos Skyway offices and they never even said "sorry" they just simply told me that the flight was rescheduled to 10:30, and that the flight already left. I never got an explanation, just that they sent me an email (which they didn't). Their only option to "help" me was to hire me a driver to drive me from Houeisay to Vientiane. 15 HOURS later and one battle with motion sickness later I finally rolled into Vientiane at 06:10 with one hour to spare before my flight from Vientiane to Bangkok. To be fair, they did hire the driver for us to drive us, but c'mon, I spent an entire day on my vacation riding through the treacherous roads of rural Laos, and never even got a refund or an apology. It was absolutely horrible, and due to no fault of my own other than trusting this company, I was subjected to a 15 hour over-night car ride. Absolutely horrendous. I give them a 1/5 simple because TripAdvisor won't let me give them a 0
reviews.author: Jimmy M

reviews.title: Fly at your own risk
reviews.text: My flight from Xiengkhoang to Vientiane on flight LK213 on 15 Oct was cancelled. The airline informed us 2 days before the flight through an email with little advice on what we can do next. We desperately tried to find a flight to Vientiane and managed to find one on Laos Airline. I enquired later about refund and was told that I will get it within 45 days. With such reliability and responsibility, I am not to sure if I'll get my money back. Based on the reviews I've read, I decided to take a chance on this airline since a number of recent reviews were fairly positive and the fair was cheaper. To be fair, I had no major issues with two other flights. One from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and the other from Luang Prabang to Xiengkhouang. The plane from LP to XH is a much smaller plane than the one we took from VT to LP. It can probably take up to 10 passengers. It's wobbly on ascending and descending. Quite scary for us but when in the air, the scenery of fields and mountains was lovely. For us, we will not take this airline again. We found the flight on Laos Airline more comfortable, reliable and secure. We don't mind paying another US$ 25.
reviews.author: Forest1006

reviews.title: Good surprise
reviews.text: Have never heard of the airline and only ended up booking as the night bus seemed very dangerous but had a very positive surprise ! Did not show on the tracker and actual time ended up 30 minutes earlier than what the ticket said but otherwise all went fine! Just get early to the airport ☺️
reviews.author: PoisonVivi

reviews.title: Quick Flight
reviews.text: Took a while to get confirmation when I booked flights online and then they had the wrong month but they fixed it withing 5mins - all good. At the airport everything went smoothly, we left early on an easy flight - were served water and cookies. Would fly again using Lao Skyway.
reviews.author: Maree R

reviews.title: Okay , small seats
reviews.text: Flew from VTE to LPQ , it was a short flight in an ATR aircraft . Was served a small butter crossiant and water . The seats did not have enough leg room . There was not enough space to keep your hand bag or briefcase under the seat . The propellers are a bit noisy . Service fair .
reviews.author: Indianworldtraveller

reviews.title: Basic service, but adequate
reviews.text: Check in straightforward, boarded on time. Basic service but adequate. Aircraft rather noisy but a comfortable journey overall.
reviews.author: donandkeo

reviews.title: Refunded at last!
reviews.text: After being charged twice. I finally received a refund. 45 days later. Communications and customer service were terrible, by lao standards. Being that this carrier has no competition I guess they don't need to try very hard. Flights and aeroplane staff were good. Billing services and after care. ... very lacking
reviews.author: gabeawilson

reviews.title: Charged twice!
reviews.text: The bad- charged twice for one flight. No response to my complaint. I have written twice by email to different address. Called twice to be disconnected once and then hung up on due to my poor laos and her poor English. The good- the flight was absolutely fine. Except that I paid twice. I wouldn't recommend this airline. They have no customer care.
reviews.author: gabeawilson

reviews.title: It Works
reviews.text: I was irritated by vad reviews and the fact that this flight, LK265 from Luang Prabang to Vientiane, never shows up on flightradar nor othe online flight trackers. However, checkin went smoothly, I got a free extra legroom seat, and the flight was on time. Would book again.
reviews.author: Daniel B

reviews.title: Perfect price-quality ratio
reviews.text: Online booking system is old fashioned, but for the rest: we didn't pay extra for a backpack, we got a snack and water on the plane and because we are tall Dutchmen we got the seats with extra legroom (for free). So, what's there not to like? They don't offer an online incheck possibility, but inchecking on Luang Prabang airport went very smooth.
reviews.author: Pim L

reviews.title: Avoid if time is of the essence!!
reviews.text: Flight was in a 12seater single engine plane & took just over 30 minutes, and we were 4 passengers. The flight was excellent, a little bumpy but nothing out of the ordinary. This is the airport for the Plain of Jars, so from Luang Prabang its either this flight or an 8 hour mountainous road journey. It is funny to be weighed yourself as well as your luggage, but all in all definitely recommended. My reservations, their scheduling is like the national lottery so unless you are VERY flexible, maybe avoid, our outbound 14.15 flight was moved to 13.15 without notice, and our 13.15 return flight was moved to 10.15 but fortunately the ticket seller was advised & advised me.
reviews.author: PHILLIP T

reviews.title: Hesitatefor no reason
reviews.text: I have just arrived in Vientiane after my flight from Luang Prabang and I have to admit that before I got to the airport I was very nervous as anyone I mentioned my flight to only had negatives things to say, but my flight went off without a hitch. There was no queue for check in, the flight departed earlier so we arrived earlier. The planes do look a little older and the are smaller but I had the same leg room as other smaller places I’ve been on. Overall I would fly with Lao Skyway again, especially as my ticket was half the price of other airlines, and I got the same results as if I had paid more.
reviews.author: Stephanie H

reviews.title: Interesting Aircraft
reviews.text: Great little airline with a wonderful collection of planes. Not much legroom in the MA60's but the planes are rarely full and the emergency exit row does have room. Much cheaper than Lao Airlines. I've flown with them several times and never had a problem.
reviews.author: Grahame H

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: They scammed us so be aware. There are two airlines operating. If they all together have few enough passengers for one planer, theyll send you an email moving your flight time till when the other plane leaves, then when you arrivevthey will say they canceled your flight, so that you have to buy a new one from the other company, which will be even pricier. Beware this scam!
reviews.author: kornelius00

reviews.title: Great budget airline
reviews.text: I was dubious after somewhat negative online reviews and comments from a few locals. Their key concerns included the safety, timeliness and quality of the service. However, i was really impressed by the Lao Skyway service - better than European budget airlines, and better than Air Asia. I flew with them twice in Dec 17. POSITIVES - cheap flights - free checked in bag allowance - quick counter check in service (no need to do online) - early/ timely flight departure and arrival, both flights i took - clean, quality plane - Good service on board by staff - Give water and a snack - Provide umbrellas for the walk in the heat between airport and plane Overall, a really good experience for a budget flight - and much better than Air Asia.
reviews.author: Sonal3

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: I cannot contact with the team to refund my money as my flight was cancelled due to bad weather. When I came to the office they said that they will refund to my credit card because I paid by credit card. After 1 month I didn't receive any information. I tried to contact via email (service@ and info@), also via Facebook (the status is seen but no reply).
reviews.author: Tessa_Nguyen

reviews.title: Wow.
reviews.text: Couldn't hear any announcements over the engine roar. We were put in the front seats which allowed approximately 20cm of leg room No exageration. My feet only just fit on the floor and I am only a size 7. Feel for someone if they had a size 10. No window and plain wall right in front of your face. Bags took along time to come onto belt. Only good thing was we left on time and got to where we were going.
reviews.author: BLuvsBali

reviews.title: Early and Great Service
reviews.text: This was my 4th flight, and as always, they departed early, as all passengers were on board. On my most recent flight, my baggage was mistakenly left behind. The staff immediately called Luang Prabang, transferred the bag to a Lao Airlines flight, and stayed at work to ensure they could personally give me my bag. Further, the head office offered me a special deal on my next flight. Finally, their prices are the lowest. I paid less than $100 R/T Vientiane-Luang Prabang. No airline could top that! Thank you Lao Skyway
reviews.author: Bernie R

reviews.title: Just like flying in regional australia
reviews.text: We almost didn't fly on Lao Skyways as the only review I could find was negative (yes, prior to flying I could only see 1 solitary review). BUT, the price was excellent and the times of the flights were perfect, so we bit the bullet ... and I'm happy to say, we were very plesantly surprised. The plane was in excellent condition (although husband was worried when we had to climb the ladder stairs lol), the flight left and arrived on time, the food was great, the service friendly and helpful. There were some turbulance (but you can't blame the airline for that!) The flights we took were only about 50 minutes long - so no inflight entertainment, but by the time we took off, ate our snack, and landed, there wasn't time for anything else really. It was honestly no different to flying from Hervey Bay (where I live) to Brisbane. Plane was about the same size, flight about the same time, and the food on Lao Skyway was actually a bit better than regional australia. And the price was great. I initially only booked one way - just to make sure it was safe - but ended up booking the return journey on Lao Skyways too. And both flights were great.
reviews.author: Smudge L

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I just took a flight from Phonsavan to Vientiane. Lao Skyway deserves a 100% perfect score. The people at the small airport at the destination were delightful and we had the small STOL aircraft to ourselves, just the two of us. We took off and landed on time ( almost unheard of in Laos), and a shuttle van was waiting for us at the airport in Vientiane. I noticed that the pilot steered around inclement weather and that was thoughtful of him. And the kicker to all of this is that they have a promotion and the cost was half of what their competitor charges. All good.
reviews.author: Lance12345
